defmodule UploadConsumer do
  @moduledoc """
  Consumes messages from the upload queue and processes metadata
  extraction for user-uploaded files.
  """
  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @allowed_extensions ~w(.jpg .png .gif .pdf .docx)
  @max_file_size 50_000_000

  defstruct [:channel, :queue_name, :processor_pid]

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(opts) do
    queue_name = Keyword.get(opts, :queue_name, "uploads")
    {:ok, channel} = connect_to_queue(queue_name)
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{channel: channel, queue_name: queue_name}}
  end

  def handle_info({:basic_deliver, payload, meta}, state) do
    case Jason.decode(payload) do
      {:ok, message} ->
        process_upload_message(message, state)
      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.error("Failed to decode message: #{inspect(reason)}")
    end
    {:noreply, state}
  end

  defp process_upload_message(%{"type" => "metadata_extract"} = msg, state) do
    with {:ok, file_path} <- validate_file_path(msg["file_path"]),
         {:ok, _size} <- validate_file_size(file_path),
         {:ok, ext} <- validate_extension(file_path) do
      metadata = extract_metadata(file_path, msg)
      store_metadata(msg["upload_id"], metadata)
      acknowledge(state.channel, msg)
    else
      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.warn("Upload validation failed: #{inspect(reason)}")
        reject(state.channel, msg)
    end
  end

  defp process_upload_message(%{"type" => "transform"} = msg, state) do
    with {:ok, file_path} <- validate_file_path(msg["file_path"]),
         {:ok, transform_spec} <- parse_transform_spec(msg["spec"]) do
      apply_transform(file_path, transform_spec, msg)
      acknowledge(state.channel, msg)
    else
      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.warn("Transform failed: #{inspect(reason)}")
        reject(state.channel, msg)
    end
  end

  defp process_upload_message(_msg, state) do
    Logger.debug("Unknown message type, ignoring")
    {:noreply, state}
  end

  defp validate_file_path(nil), do: {:error, :missing_path}
  defp validate_file_path(path) do
    normalized = Path.expand(path)
    upload_dir = Application.get_env(:upload_consumer, :upload_dir, "/var/uploads")
    if String.starts_with?(normalized, upload_dir) do
      {:ok, normalized}
    else
      {:error, :path_traversal}
    end
  end

  defp validate_file_size(path) do
    case File.stat(path) do
      {:ok, %{size: size}} when size <= @max_file_size -> {:ok, size}
      {:ok, _} -> {:error, :file_too_large}
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp validate_extension(path) do
    ext = Path.extname(path) |> String.downcase()
    if ext in @allowed_extensions, do: {:ok, ext}, else: {:error, :invalid_extension}
  end

  defp extract_metadata(file_path, msg) do
    base_metadata = %{
      "filename" => Path.basename(file_path),
      "size" => File.stat!(file_path).size,
      "extension" => Path.extname(file_path),
      "uploaded_at" => DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.to_iso8601()
    }

    case msg["custom_fields"] do
      nil -> base_metadata
      fields when is_list(fields) -> merge_custom_fields(base_metadata, fields, msg)
      _ -> base_metadata
    end
  end

  defp merge_custom_fields(metadata, fields, msg) do
    Enum.reduce(fields, metadata, fn field_spec, acc ->
      case field_spec do
        %{"name" => name, "source" => source} when is_binary(name) and is_binary(source) ->
          value = resolve_field_source(source, msg)
          Map.put(acc, sanitize_key(name), value)
        _ ->
          acc
      end
    end)
  end

  defp resolve_field_source(source, msg) do
    # Resolve dot-notation paths like "metadata.author" from the message
    parts = String.split(source, ".")
    resolve_nested(parts, msg)
  end

  defp resolve_nested([], value), do: value
  defp resolve_nested([key | rest], map) when is_map(map) do
    resolve_nested(rest, Map.get(map, key))
  end
  defp resolve_nested(_, _), do: nil

  defp sanitize_key(key) do
    key
    |> String.replace(~r/[^a-zA-Z0-9_]/, "_")
    |> String.slice(0, 64)
  end

  defp parse_transform_spec(nil), do: {:error, :missing_spec}
  defp parse_transform_spec(spec) when is_map(spec) do
    with {:ok, operation} <- validate_operation(spec["operation"]),
         {:ok, params} <- validate_params(spec["params"]) do
      {:ok, %{operation: operation, params: params}}
    end
  end
  defp parse_transform_spec(_), do: {:error, :invalid_spec}

  defp validate_operation(op) when op in ["resize", "crop", "rotate", "compress"] do
    {:ok, String.to_existing_atom(op)}
  end
  defp validate_operation(_), do: {:error, :invalid_operation}

  defp validate_params(params) when is_map(params), do: {:ok, params}
  defp validate_params(_), do: {:error, :invalid_params}

  defp apply_transform(file_path, %{operation: op, params: params}, msg) do
    template = get_transform_template(op, params, msg)
    execute_transform(template, file_path)
  end

  defp get_transform_template(operation, params, msg) do
    base_template = Application.get_env(:upload_consumer, :transform_templates, %{})
    user_template = msg["template_override"]

    case user_template do
      nil ->
        Map.get(base_template, operation, default_template(operation))
      override when is_binary(override) ->
        # Allow user-specified template expressions for custom workflows
        interpolate_template(override, params)
    end
  end

  defp interpolate_template(template, params) do
    # Process template with EEx for dynamic parameter substitution
    bindings = Enum.map(params, fn {k, v} -> {String.to_atom(k), v} end)
    EEx.eval_string(template, bindings)
  end

  defp default_template(:resize), do: "convert -resize #{:width}x#{:height}"
  defp default_template(:crop), do: "convert -crop #{:width}x#{:height}+#{:x}+#{:y}"
  defp default_template(:rotate), do: "convert -rotate #{:degrees}"
  defp default_template(:compress), do: "convert -quality #{:quality}"

  defp execute_transform(command, file_path) when is_binary(command) do
    output_path = file_path <> ".transformed"
    full_command = "#{command} #{file_path} #{output_path}"
    Logger.info("Executing transform: #{full_command}")
    System.cmd("sh", ["-c", full_command], stderr_to_stdout: true)
  end
  defp execute_transform(_, _), do: {:error, :invalid_template}

  defp store_metadata(upload_id, metadata) do
    # Store to database
    Logger.info("Storing metadata for upload #{upload_id}")
    :ok
  end

  defp acknowledge(_channel, _msg), do: :ok
  defp reject(_channel, _msg), do: :ok

  defp connect_to_queue(queue_name) do
    Logger.info("Connecting to queue: #{queue_name}")
    {:ok, %{name: queue_name}}
  end
end
